items.name: Marco Polo
items.blurb: Marco Polo (1254–1324): A Venetian traveller who wrote about China.
clues: He told his stories to a writer while in prison in Genoa.
He travelled the Silk Road with his father and uncle.
He served the Mongol ruler Kublai Khan.
Born in 1254.
Nationality: Venetian.
He was a Venetian traveller who wrote about China.

items.name: Ibn Battuta
items.blurb: Ibn Battuta (1304–1368): A Muslim explorer of Africa and Asia.
clues: He was born in Tangier.
He travelled for nearly 30 years.
He covered more distance than any known traveller before the steam age.
Born in 1304.
Nationality: Moroccan.
He was a Muslim explorer of Africa and Asia.

items.name: Zheng He
items.blurb: Zheng He (1371–1433): A Chinese admiral and explorer.
clues: He was a Muslim admiral of the Ming dynasty.
His treasure ships were among the largest wooden ships ever built.
He led seven voyages to Asia and East Africa.
Born in 1371.
Nationality: Chinese.
He was a Chinese admiral and explorer.

items.name: Christopher Columbus
items.blurb: Christopher Columbus (1451–1506): Sailed across the Atlantic for Spain in 1492.
clues: He was born in Genoa.
He thought he had reached Asia.
His ships included the Niña, the Pinta and the Santa María.
Born in 1451.
Nationality: Genoese.
He sailed across the Atlantic for Spain in 1492.

items.name: Ferdinand Magellan
items.blurb: Ferdinand Magellan (1480–1521): Led the first expedition to sail around the world.
clues: He was killed in the Philippines in 1521.
A strait at the tip of South America is named after him.
He named the Pacific Ocean.
Born in 1480.
Nationality: Portuguese.
He led the first expedition to sail around the world.

items.name: Hernán Cortés
items.blurb: Hernán Cortés (1485–1547): Brought about the fall of the Aztec Empire.
clues: He landed on the coast of Mexico in 1519.
He met the ruler Moctezuma II.
He is called a conquistador.
Born in 1485.
Nationality: Spanish.
He brought about the fall of the Aztec Empire.

items.name: Abel Tasman
items.blurb: Abel Tasman (1603–1659): A Dutch seafarer.
clues: He worked for the Dutch East India Company.
He was the first known European to reach New Zealand.
An island state of Australia is named after him.
Born in 1603.
Nationality: Dutch.
He was a Dutch seafarer.

items.name: James Cook
items.blurb: James Cook (1728–1779): Charted the east coast of Australia.
clues: He was killed in Hawaii in 1779.
He mapped the coast of New Zealand.
His ship on his first voyage was HMS Endeavour.
Born in 1728.
Nationality: British.
He charted the east coast of Australia.

items.name: David Livingstone
items.blurb: David Livingstone (1813–1873): A Scottish explorer of Africa.
clues: He was a missionary doctor.
He was the first European to see Victoria Falls.
Born in 1813.
Nationality: Scottish.
He was a Scottish explorer of Africa.

items.name: Matthew Henson
items.blurb: Matthew Henson (1866–1955): An African American Arctic explorer.
clues: He spoke the Inuit language.
He travelled with Robert Peary for over 20 years.
He was part of the 1909 expedition that claimed to reach the North Pole.
Born in 1866.
Nationality: American.
He was an African American Arctic explorer.

items.name: Robert Falcon Scott
items.blurb: Robert Falcon Scott (1868–1912): Led the doomed Terra Nova expedition.
clues: His ship on his first Antarctic expedition was the Discovery.
He died on the return journey in 1912.
He reached the South Pole a month after Roald Amundsen.
Born in 1868.
Nationality: British.
He led the doomed Terra Nova expedition.

items.name: Roald Amundsen
items.blurb: Roald Amundsen (1872–1928): The first person to reach the South Pole.
clues: He was the first to sail through the Northwest Passage.
He relied on sled dogs to reach his goal.
He reached the South Pole in December 1911.
Born in 1872.
Nationality: Norwegian.
He was the first person to reach the South Pole.

items.name: Ernest Shackleton
items.blurb: Ernest Shackleton (1874–1922): Brought all his men home after their ship sank.
clues: He sailed 1,300 km in a small lifeboat to get help.
His ship Endurance was crushed by ice.
He led an expedition that tried to cross Antarctica.
Born in 1874.
Nationality: Irish-born British.
He brought all his men home after their ship sank.

items.name: Amelia Earhart
items.blurb: Amelia Earhart (1897–1939): A famous American aviator.
clues: She vanished over the Pacific in 1937.
She tried to fly around the world.
She was the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic.
Born in 1897.
Nationality: American.
She was a famous American aviator.

items.name: Charles Lindbergh
items.blurb: Charles Lindbergh (1902–1974): Made the first solo non-stop flight across the Atlantic.
clues: His aircraft was called the Spirit of St. Louis.
He flew from New York to Paris in 1927.
He won a large cash prize for his flight.
Born in 1902.
Nationality: American.
He made the first solo non-stop flight across the Atlantic.

items.name: Jacques Cousteau
items.blurb: Jacques Cousteau (1910–1997): A French ocean explorer.
clues: His ship was called Calypso.
He made films about life under the sea.
He co-invented the Aqua-Lung.
Born in 1910.
Nationality: French.
He was a French ocean explorer.

items.name: Tenzing Norgay
items.blurb: Tenzing Norgay (1914–1986): One of the first two people to climb Everest.
clues: He was a Sherpa from the Khumbu region.
He had tried to climb the mountain six times before.
He reached the summit in 1953 with Edmund Hillary.
Born in 1914.
Nationality: Nepali.
He was one of the first two people to climb Everest.

items.name: Edmund Hillary
items.blurb: Edmund Hillary (1919–2008): One of the first two people to climb Mount Everest.
clues: He was a beekeeper.
He drove a tractor to the South Pole.
He reached the top of Everest in 1953 with Tenzing Norgay.
Born in 1919.
Nationality: New Zealander.
He was one of the first two people to climb Mount Everest.

items.name: Neil Armstrong
items.blurb: Neil Armstrong (1930–2012): The first person to walk on the Moon.
clues: He was a test pilot who flew the X-15 rocket plane.
He commanded Gemini 8.
He said That's one small step for man.
Born in 1930.
Nationality: American.
He was the first person to walk on the Moon.

items.name: Buzz Aldrin
items.blurb: Buzz Aldrin (1930): The second person to walk on the Moon.
clues: He was the pilot of the lunar module Eagle.
He walked on the Moon with Neil Armstrong.
Born in 1930.
Nationality: American.
He was the second person to walk on the Moon.

items.name: Yuri Gagarin
items.blurb: Yuri Gagarin (1934–1968): The first human in space.
clues: He died in a jet crash in 1968.
His spacecraft was called Vostok 1.
He orbited the Earth once in 1961.
Born in 1934.
Nationality: Soviet.
He was the first human in space.

img.credit: В. Жихаренко / ТАСС Обработка: Roman Kubanskiy

items.name: Valentina Tereshkova
items.blurb: Valentina Tereshkova (1937): The first woman in space.
clues: She was a factory worker and amateur parachutist.
Her call sign was Chaika, meaning seagull.
She flew Vostok 6 in 1963.
Born in 1937.
Nationality: Soviet.
She was the first woman in space.

items.name: Sally Ride
items.blurb: Sally Ride (1951–2012): The first American woman in space.
clues: She had a PhD in physics.
She flew on the space shuttle Challenger.
She was the youngest American in space at the time.
Born in 1951.
Nationality: American.
She was the first American woman in space.
